tools.name: dependency_preflight
tools.description: Check an npm or PyPI package version against OSV known advisories, fetch the latest published release, compare current vs latest advisories, return provenance and actionable cautious upgrade guidance. No package download or code execution; limited beta usage.

tools.name: release_gate
tools.description: Pre-deployment advisory preflight for up to 3 exact npm/PyPI package releases in one MCP call, using verifiable registry versions and OSV known advisories. Returns review-needed flags and provenance; never auto-upgrades.

tools.name: ecosystem_catalog
tools.description: Find project-owned MCP tools for related agent operations, without redirects, tracking, unsolicited connections or paid calls.

tools.name: radar_methodology
tools.description: Get data source attributions, data freshness, safeguards, boundaries and budget policies for Agent Dependency Radar.
